subject: Next 30d: POC success checklist & owner commitments
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Lucy Khan <lucy.khan@brightlane.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-21T16:12:00Z
Subject: Next 30d: POC success checklist & owner commitments

Hi Lucy — great conversation earlier. This thread is a short post-call recap + the concrete 30-day success plan so we have clear owners and acceptance criteria. Please review and flag anything we missed.

Summary of call
- Goal: validate that Redwood inference reduces average generative latency below 200ms p50 for their clinical summarization pipeline while keeping token cost within target budget.
- Primary success metrics: p50 latency < 200ms, throughput 50 concurrent sessions with <2% error rate, fidelity (ROUGE-like) within 3% of baseline.
- Data: BrightLane will run a synthetic batch of 2k redacted notes and share sample workload.

Proposed 30-day plan (owners & dates)
1) Week 0 (this week) — Onboarding + test dataset (Owner: Lucy / BrightLane) — deliver: redacted sample set and network test window by 2026-08-25.
2) Week 1 — Baseline run + config (Owner: Marissa Cole, Redwood) — deliver: initial run with default model, token/unit cost estimate by 2026-08-28.
3) Week 2 — Optimization pass (Owner: Ben Carter, Redwood) — deliver: batching/kv-cache config, quantization recommendation by 2026-09-04.
4) Week 3 — Acceptance window (Owners: Lucy + Sean) — deliver: evaluation report vs success criteria and decision recommendation by 2026-09-11.

Immediate asks from BrightLane
- Share redacted sample set and expected concurrency profile (peak and average).
- Provide any IP/end-to-end latency constraints (e.g., max acceptable RTT to region).

Attachments: POC_Success_Checklist.xlsx (live checklist we will track), Network_Security_Table.pdf (preliminary network requirements).

If agreeable, I'll schedule three 30-minute checkpoints (Tue weekly) and one final 60-minute acceptance review. Thanks again for the time — excited to get this moving.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

From: Lucy Khan <lucy.khan@brightlane.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-24T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Next 30d: POC success checklist & owner commitments

Thanks Sean — this is helpful and aligns with what we discussed. Quick clarifications:
- We can deliver a 2k redacted set and the typical concurrency profile (avg 30, peak 60) by EOD 8/25.
- For regulatory reasons we need the network egress to stay in us-west-2 where our primary VPC sits; please confirm Redwood can pin the region.
- On fidelity metric: our internal QA team measures summary accuracy against clinician notes; we can share a sample evaluation rubric by 8/27.

We'll accept the proposed checkpoints; please send calendar invites. One ask: can Redwood run an initial baseline on a subset (500 notes) earlier so we have a quick read by 8/28?

Best,
Lucy
Lucy Khan
Director of AI Products, BrightLane Health
lucy.khan@brightlane.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lucy Khan <lucy.khan@brightlane.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-25T18:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Next 30d: POC success checklist & owner commitments

Lucy / Sean — noted on region (us-west-2) and the evaluation rubric. Action items from Redwood side, committed dates:
- 2026-08-26: Redwood will run an initial baseline on 500-note subset (Ben to coordinate ingestion).
- 2026-08-28: Share baseline latency + cost snapshot (Marissa).
- 2026-09-04: Deliver optimization pass with specific batching/quant settings and expected cost delta (Ben).
- 2026-09-11: Final acceptance review and recommendation (Sean + Lucy).

Marissa here — I'll own the coordination of test runs and maintain the attached checklist; Ben will run the kernel and quant experiments. I'll schedule the weekly 30-minute check-ins for Tue 10:00 PT starting 2026-08-31 and will share invites now.

Quick note on security questionnaire: procurement@brightlane — if you need anything from our SOC/Security pack, ping me and I'll loop security.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lucy Khan <lucy.khan@brightlane.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-02T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Next 30d: POC success checklist & owner commitments

Quick weekly nudge — baseline on 500 notes completed earlier today. Early signals: p50 ~ 260ms on default model in us-west-2 (3rd-party NB instance), token cost estimate ~ $0.007/token at current batch size. I'll upload raw logs + perf dashboard link to the Drive folder in the related_links.

Next steps for this week (Ben owner)
- 9/04: Run batching + KV-cache enabled run and share delta.
- 9/04: Small quantization pass (4-bit where feasible) to estimate cost/latency tradeoff.

Lucy — if you can drop the sample evaluation rubric into the Drive folder, we'll map our metrics to your QA checks ahead of acceptance window.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Performance Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
